headline: Tombat Ultrasonic Sensor
title: Tombat | Ultrasonic Sensor Find Dungeons And Chests | Palworld Guide
video_script: Can't find a dungeon? Use Tombat. Its partner skill, Ultrasonic Sensor, uses ultrasonic waves to detect nearby dungeons, treasure chests and scrap. It is a handy scout for explorers. At base it works Mining at level three, with Gathering and Transporting at level two. How many chests has Tombat found for you? Comment below!
description: Tombat in Palworld 1.0: Ultrasonic Sensor detects nearby dungeons, treasure chests and scrap, and it works Mining at level three.
